agfa_print_cp30.name: Agfa Print CP30
agfa_print_cp30.densitometry_as_printed: status A (LAD for xenon light: R 1.15, G 1.05, B 1.05)
agfa_print_cp30.sensitivity_as_printed: log sensitivity vs wavelength (density criterion not printed; 1.0 recorded as standard for ECP-2 print films)
notes: Agfa plots sensitometric density scaled by 100 (0..450 for 0.00..4.50 D); the y-axis calibration maps directly to density units.

Per-dye spectral density curves (C, M, Y and neutral at D=3.00) span the full 380-780 nm range and satisfy C + M + Y = Neutral within 0.012 D across the spectrum (pure net dye densities without base; no base subtraction or donor fill needed).

Spectral sensitivity is drawn continuously over 376-770 nm (R), 376-600 nm (G), and 376-548 nm (B), reaching 2.2-2.6 decades below peak; Kodak 2383 tail shape only fills the far-out-of-band ends (<= 0.7% of raw exposure).

CP30 has genuine far-red sensitivity peaking at 701 nm (35% of red exposure above 700 nm, matching Agfa's page 3 warning on far-red absorption in optical glass). On cine negatives whose base density reaches 780 nm (Vision3) it matches Kodak 2383 within 0.5-2.2 CC; on negatives whose published base density stops at 700 nm (null = opaque above 700 nm) it requires higher M/Y compensation.

gate_exceptions.reason: Agfa's sensitometric curves are 37-41-point piecewise-linear polylines with a small kink around Relative Log Exposure 1.45-1.55 (D ~ 2.0-2.6); three norm_cdfs per channel miss blue by up to 0.0326 D and green by 0.0229 D there (red within 0.0168 D), while status-A remix stays within 0.027-0.034 D up to D 2.0.
